dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL with PostgreSQL via MCP interface; ORCSGETTEMP and ORCDBMAIN calls are ORCA-specific runtime

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software — comprehensive check master (包括チェックマスタ) update processing
purpose.summary: This batch subprogram updates the comprehensive-check master table (tbl_hktsantei_master) in the ORCA medical receipt database. It reads an input update file containing insert/update/delete records, applies each operation to the DB via the MCP interface, and writes proof and error output files.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with LNK-AREA (called as subprogram)
MCP DB interface (DBSELECT, DBINSERT, DBUPDATE, DBDELETE) via PERFORM 900-ORCDBMAIN-SEC
COPY of multiple ORCA-specific copybooks (CPHKTSANTEIWK.INC, CPHKTSANTEI.INC, CPJOBKANRI.INC, MCPAREA, MCPDATA.INC, CPMUPLINK.INC, ENUM-VALUE, CPORCSGETTEMP.INC)
EVALUATE on SYORIKBN (I/U/D) for insert/update/delete dispatch
LINE SEQUENTIAL files for input, error, and proof output
grpsys indicator labels on DB-call PERFORM statements
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; remaining ~13500 bytes not shown but pattern is consistent. The 'grpsys' tokens in columns 1-6 appear to be group/section markers used by the ORCA build system rather than standard COBOL syntax — they are treated as comment-area content in fixed format. No COMP-3 usage; no EXEC SQL (DB access is via ORCA MCP layer).
